items.title: New vision shows moment airborne car hit Brisbane bus
items.description: New CCTV vision, captured from inside the bus, shows the moment the car ploughed into it, its front wheels coming to rest on a bus seat.

items.title: Hens moved indoors but free-range label still allowed
items.description: The consumer watchdog has relaxed rules on free-range labelling as egg producers move their hens indoors to prevent the spread of bird flu.

items.title: Infantino could face UEFA lawsuit as he scrambles for FIFA presidency support
items.description: European football body UEFA threatens FIFA with legal action over Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell a stake in future World Cup profits to private investors.

items.title: Live: Minister tells Hanson to 'turn up and answer questions' after barring ABC, Guardian
items.description: Amanda Rishworth says Pauline Hanson must "turn up and answer questions" after the One Nation leader barred ABC and Guardian journalists from a press conference in Victoria. Follow live.

items.title: 'Get this right': Top US Jewish leader's stark warning for Australia
items.description: The leader of one of the world's most high-profile Jewish organisations says Australia faces a crucial test on how it tackles the rise of antisemitism.

items.title: Ukraine drone strike on Russian holiday spot kills 11
items.description: At least 11 people are dead and dozens are wounded after Ukrainian strikes on a Russian beach resort and the Crimean Peninsula.

items.title: Allegra Spender on the hardest decision she's ever made
items.description: Allegra Spender discusses her fashion mogul mother Carla Zampatti, the "joy" of politics and why no Liberal Party leader has ever tried to lure her into the fold.

items.title: The vulnerable workers bearing the cost of providing Australia with cheap food
items.description: Behind the fruit and vegetables on Australia's supermarket shelves are workers whose stories are rarely heard.

items.title: Older people open to downsizing but facing barriers
items.description: Research shows more than half of people over the age of 55 are open to downsizing. But experts say there are barriers stopping older people moving into smaller homes.

items.title: School founder said 5-year-old behaved 'suggestively', parent claims
items.description: Six women detail disturbing allegations of abuse and sexualised behaviour from the 1970s through the late 2000s at a controversial alternative school in Melbourne.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
